context: The cleanup sweep can now free the calling session's own agent lock on a work tree that is clean, merged into main and quiet for 30 minutes. It ships this way (merged in batch #586). The reviewer worried that a mid-session sweep could free a still-running agent's tree under those conditions.

options.gain: The offered fast cleanup after a merge actually cleans.
options.how: Any sweep, mid-session or at session end, may free its own session's lock under the clean, merged, idle-30-minutes test.
options.label: Yes, keep it as built
options.lose: A quiet agent's tree can go; it is clean and merged, so no work is lost.

options.gain: No tree goes while its session runs.
options.how: A follow-up lane limits the own-lock rule to the sweep that runs at session end.
options.label: Only the session-end sweep
options.lose: Trees stay until the session ends, which is the leftover-tree problem c44 set out to fix.

ref: c44 (merged work leaves no worktrees behind), PR #590
title: Let a mid-session cleanup sweep free its own session's locks
why: The tree must be clean and merged, so nothing can be lost; the cost is at most a rebuild of a work tree.
